items.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013

ctx.x: He’s a good guy. © Fillius Jazz Archive -24-

He’s a character. You know, I’ve got to tell you a funny story. This was the first time he went to Europe with Cannonball. They were in Paris. And they’d meet in the lobby for a sound check, and there’s no Louis. And they’re waiting around for Louis. So here he comes, after they’d been waiting about twenty minutes. He comes in the hotel and he’s just shaking his hands like — ooo. They said, “Louis, man, where you been? We’ve been waiting for you.” He said, “man, I went to take a walk, man, it’s incredible man.”…
All right. Well we used up the tape here. I thoroughly enjoyed this.
